name: @sonofg0tham/quell-scanner
description: Two offline engines for AI tooling: secret detection (regex + Shannon entropy) and prompt-injection detection (Unicode smuggling, bidi overrides, homoglyphs). Zero runtime dependencies. The core of the Quell VSCode extension.

scripts.test: tsc -p ./tsconfig.test.json && node dist-test/test/SecretScanner.test.js && node dist-test/test/PromptGuard.test.js && node dist-test/test/EnvRedactor.test.js

author: Craig McCart
